# ColdStartBench

ColdStartBench records fresh AI coding-agent trials against unfamiliar developer tools. Current v0.1 records externally executed checks; it does not run them.

- Overview and quick start: [README.md](README.md)
- AI contribution instructions and invariants: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)
- Copyable evaluator prompt: [docs/AI_USAGE.md](docs/AI_USAGE.md)
- Complete example trial and report: [examples/clean-trial/](examples/clean-trial/)
- CLI source entry point: [scripts/coldstartbench.mjs](scripts/coldstartbench.mjs)
- Event and report schema: [docs/event-schema.md](docs/event-schema.md)
